data.description: SPK-01 (w3), SPK-02 (w3), SPK-04 (w2), SPK-15 (w1 rider), CNT-10 share. (1) FIX THE MEMBERSHIPS GAP FIRST: grep 'INTO memberships' src/ returns only the demo reseeder — runtime-created speakers are invisible on any memberships-derived surface. Either write memberships(role=speaker) at the acceptance boundary or make the roster participation-derived; the onboarding board must read the same truth. Remove owedCount===0 vanishing for roster purposes (onboarding.queries.ts:300). (2) /speakers route + sidebar 'Speakers', new speakers.routes.ts over people JOIN participations JOIN submissions(event) — same join quick-search uses. Search + filters. (3) Add/edit speaker incl BIO (admin create currently inserts bio as literal NULL, submission-record.routes.ts:671); SHARE the portal's updateProfile normalizer (portal.routes.ts:1303) — two normalizers = SPK-08 divergence. Audit rows on organizer edits. (4) Status: per-session confirmation_status rollup badge + filter + organizer override; NO new person-level status column. (5) Riders: custom_fields JSON + logistics section; wire the dead ?person= quick-search deep link on roster + onboarding. Constraint from CRM scoping: keep the model person-centric so a future CRM layers on cleanly. Full spec: section T-D1. Register rows 16,17,19,20,24n.
data.title: Speaker roster and person CRUD

data.body:
MRQ-111 complete — PR #80 open, status pr_open. Gate green locally:

npm run pr-gate -- --ticket MRQ-111
{ "command": "pr-gate", "ticket": "MRQ-111", "status": "pass", "elapsedMs": 73131, "budgetMs": 120000 }

Ran with the box's 1-min load spiking to 89. check:api pass (registry regenerated, four new ops reach the CLI), check:design pass, trace:ac pass, three typechecks + production build clean.

DEVIATE-WITH-FLAG (your call): the ticket says NO new person-level status column, and there is none. But SPK-S1 sets Priya's status at step 8, two steps before she has a session, so a purely participation-derived status has nowhere to land. memberships gains confirmation_status/confirmed_at/invited_at — on the person-EVENT membership, same three-value vocabulary as participations, consulted only while the person has no sessions, and written together with every session by the one override path so the two cannot disagree.

FLAG for its own ticket (pre-existing, not introduced here): eventFor checks that an event exists, not that it belongs to the principal's org. That is the house pattern across event-settings, imports, agenda, comms; program-access.ts exists for it and only forms.routes.ts:204 uses it. I did not fix it on this surface rather than create a second divergent auth pattern.

REVIEW: single headless reviewer, three rounds, FAIL -> FAIL -> PASS at 80ef5bd (artifact attached). It caught two blockers I would have shipped: a red node source-contract test, and Add-speaker wiping an existing person's title/company/bio org-wide when merging by email. Round 1 was self-reviewed inline only in the sense that I declined a second reviewer while load was 244; the single-reviewer default was otherwise followed throughout.

VALIDATION (artifact attached): real Worker on real seeded data (9,976 rows, 1,000 submissions) — 507-speaker roster in 33-38ms, full create/edit/status/logistics round-trip, plus a headless-browser pass on the actual UI. c11's embedded browser timed out twice under fleet load so that pass ran through Playwright. It caught a defect every green test missed: the record drawer at z-index 40 under the topbar's 50.

MRQ-112 contract honoured: headshot_attachment_id projected on every speaker payload, single SpeakerAvatar render hook, .speaker-files section reserved, no edits to uploads.routes.ts.
COLLISION for T-I2: this takes /speakers for the organizer roster; the public directory should land under the public site's prefix.
The person-centric roster invariant is now binding in CLAUDE.md under Rules of the road. Full reasoning is in sequence/research/speaker-crm-scope.md §2.

Rebase round 2 finished BEFORE the merge-queue call arrived, so I am parked, not mid-flight. Standing by for 'YOUR TURN' (I am #80, 8th of 9). No further rebase or force-push from me until then.

State: branch de2386d, rebased onto b526d5d, pushed and verified. Gate GREEN at low load:
  pr-gate status pass, elapsedMs 111641 / budget 120000
  91 test files, 587 tests, all passing; check:api pass, check:design pass, shell truth pass, trace:ac pass, three typechecks + build clean.
  Suite reported pass-over-budget (99.2s vs the 45s objective) — tests all pass; that is machine load, and an earlier run at load 79 took 154s. Worth the merge captain knowing the fleet's inner-loop clock is ~2.2x its objective right now.

Main has ALREADY moved past my base (b526d5d -> ccb7885), so PR #80 reads CONFLICTING again. Expected; not a defect.

Conflicts I resolved this round, for whoever sequences me next — all three recur every time:
  - cli/api-registry.json — GENERATED. Note it must be regenerated AFTER 'npx vite build', not before: a stale dist/ silently produces a registry missing the other tickets' operations (I hit exactly this — 137 ops from stale dist, 139 after a real rebuild).
  - src/ui/shell/AppShell.tsx — real. MRQ-115's FilesPage branch + my SpeakersPage branch, and OnboardingPage keeps the search prop it needs for ?person=. Both sides kept.
  - tests/unit/route-table.test.ts — merged both sides' rows: 'Speakers' (mine) and 'Files' (MRQ-115). Deleted nothing.

ROUTE COLLISION RESOLVED (the one I flagged on the PR, now real): MRQ-121 shipped a public SSR route at GET /speakers (public-agenda.route.tsx:83), which resolves before the SPA fallback, and app.tsx:27 lists /speakers as a public page. That made the organizer roster unreachable and the sidebar link a lie. I moved the organizer roster to /roster; the sidebar label is still exactly 'Speakers'. Verified live in a browser: sidebar 'Speakers' -> /roster with 508 rows, and /speakers still serves the public directory. The public URL was already shipped, so the admin path is the one that should move.

Land handoff: merged github/main through fae3926 into mrq-111-speaker-roster and pushed exact HEAD bb78a61777cf564f0698f1834bf0f550acae54bd to github. Final npm run pr-gate -- --ticket MRQ-111 PASS: 103 test files, 692 tests passed; check:api 155 operations; route map, shell truth, design, type checks, production build, and merged AC trace pass (live 229, testFiles 161, claims 67, uncovered 0). Gate elapsed 41890ms/120000; test stage 35413ms/45000, no failures. cli/api-registry.json accepted main deletion and is absent/untracked; it was not regenerated into the commit. PR #80 was not merged; status remains pr_open for Merge Warden.

Board reconciliation 2026-08-12: verified DONE. PR #80 (mrq-111-speaker-roster) merged 2026-08-12T14:52:31Z; merge commit 9082a955 confirmed an ancestor of github/main via 'git merge-base --is-ancestor'. Ticket had drifted at pr_open. The repo has zero open and zero closed-unmerged PRs, so nothing is waiting on review. Status corrected to reflect merge, not PR-open.
